view: Cyrene ruined Greek Roman theatre view from upper semicircular limestone seating down toward broken stage and green upland valley, Mediterranean haze far distance, actual hillside geometry with concentric seating, not desert dunes or Roman Colosseum.

eras.title: A theatre on the hillside
eras.caption: Cyrene's stone seating follows the slope of a greener upland above the Libyan coast. The remains of theatres, temples and streets recall a city founded by Greek settlers and reshaped under Roman rule.
